peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is a technical SEO checklist?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Crawl your site from http:// and keep an eye out for mixed content warnings, pages that don't redirect, or redirect chains. Audit your HTTP status codes. Important pages should be returning a 200, old pages should 301 to their replacements and nothing important should get a 404 or 5xx.
